Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “Communications of the group” to mean IEEE Communications Magazine based on shallow keyword matching, despite clear evidence that the canonical title fitting the “Communications of the [group]” phrasing is Communications of the ACM and that Zhengyou Zhang is an ACM Fellow. This led the investigation toward the wrong publication and publisher (IEEE/ComSoc) instead of ACM.
